description: Validate a WorldGen project through the authoritative compiler pipeline.
examples: Connect the valid output to the next route and inspect diagnostics when validation fails.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts validation when this execution route is reached.

inputs.name: project
inputs.description: Selects the WorldGen project to validate.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the project has been validated.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when validation reports a failure.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Returns the authoritative validation result.

outputs.name: diagnostics
outputs.description: Reports validation diagnostics for the project.

outputs.name: valid
outputs.description: Reports whether the project passed validation.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether validation completed successfully.

outputs.name: error_code
outputs.description: Reports the stable validation error code.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Explains the validation result.

description: Validate and compile a WorldGen project into a versioned datapack job.
examples: Connect the returned job to Get Job Status or handle Job Completed to inspect the compiled pack.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts compilation when this execution route is reached.

inputs.name: project
inputs.description: Selects the WorldGen project to compile.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the compile job has been accepted.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the compile job cannot be accepted.

outputs.name: job
outputs.description: Returns the accepted WorldGen compile job.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the compile job was accepted.

outputs.name: error_code
outputs.description: Reports the stable compile error code.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Explains the compile result.

description: Compile and install a WorldGen datapack for the server and an optional world.
examples: Leave World Name empty to install for the main server world, or select a world for an additional world-owned copy.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts installation when this execution route is reached.

inputs.name: project
inputs.description: Selects the WorldGen project to install.

inputs.name: world_name
inputs.description: Selects an optional world-owned installation target.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the install job has been accepted.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the install job cannot be accepted.

outputs.name: job
outputs.description: Returns the accepted WorldGen install job.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the install job was accepted.

outputs.name: error_code
outputs.description: Reports the stable install error code.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Explains the install result.

description: Create or replace an isolated preview world and return a cancellable job.
examples: Reuse the same Preview ID to replace an earlier preview without leaving an orphaned world.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts preview creation when this execution route is reached.

inputs.name: project
inputs.description: Selects the WorldGen project to preview.

inputs.name: preview_id
inputs.description: Identifies the isolated preview to create or replace.

inputs.name: player
inputs.description: Selects the player who should receive the preview world.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.description: Selects the environment used by the preview world.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Sets the seed used by the preview world.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the preview job has been accepted.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the preview job cannot be accepted.

outputs.name: job
outputs.description: Returns the accepted WorldGen preview job.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the preview job was accepted.

outputs.name: error_code
outputs.description: Reports the stable preview error code.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Explains the preview result.

description: Unload and remove an isolated WorldGen preview world.
examples: Provide the Preview ID used by Preview WorldGen Project to unload that isolated world.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts preview cleanup when this execution route is reached.

inputs.name: preview_id
inputs.description: Identifies the isolated preview world to remove.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the preview cleanup job has been accepted.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the preview cleanup job cannot be accepted.

outputs.name: job
outputs.description: Returns the accepted WorldGen preview cleanup job.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the preview cleanup job was accepted.

outputs.name: error_code
outputs.description: Reports the stable preview cleanup error code.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Explains the preview cleanup result.
